acceptance: Every semantic and negative case is asserted directly in unittest tests.
goal: Add a pure function summarize_budget_slots(slots) in the new module automation/command_bus/claude_jules_budget_summary.py. Input: a list of dicts that each have an int 'slot' and a str 'command_id'. Output: a dict with exactly the keys 'used', 'cap', 'remaining', 'command_ids' where cap is always 10, used is len(slots), remaining is cap - used, and command_ids lists the command ids ordered by slot. Raise ValueError when slot numbers are not exactly 1..len(slots), when a command id repeats, or when more than 10 slots are given.
negative_cases: slot numbers 1 and 3 without 2 raise ValueError
a bool slot value such as True raises ValueError
non_goals: No I/O, no GitHub access, no change to any existing module, workflow, config or document.
publication: Publish the normal isolated Jules PR only if the full unittest suite and git diff --check pass and only the two allowed files were added.
reuse: Mirror the slot/command_id field names used by automation/command_bus/claude_jules_live_budget.py; standard library only.
semantics: Slots given out of order are summarized in slot order.
stop_conditions: any existing file would need to change
